newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE steady in quiet activity and Arco news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE steady in quiet activity and Arco news.

text.p: Spot MTBE prices were steady in very quiet trade on Thursday despite some buying activity by a major refiner that suffered a slight production glitch on Wednesday, traders said.

Arco Chemical said it expects to be running its 20,000 barrel-per-day Channelview, Texas, MTBE unit at two-thirds capacity for the next two to four days after a railcar tipped over onto a feedstock line into the unit.
On Wednesday, Arco was heard buying about 70,000 to 90,000 barrels of material at values between 95.50 and 96.00 cents in the U.S. Gulf, traders said.
The range in the USG on Thursday remained 95.25/96.25 cents for prompt supply.
In New York, a 20,000-barrel parcel was done at 102.00 cents.
